scenarios.title: 00 · Normal Sinus Rhythm
scenarios.description: Maintain VVI standby pacing while observing intrinsic beats.
scenarios.objective: Confirm the pacemaker remains inhibited while the patient maintains an intrinsic sinus rate.
scenarios.feedback: No pacing spikes should be visible. If pacing occurs, lower the rate below the intrinsic rhythm or verify sensing leads.

scenarios.title: 01 · Symptomatic Ventricular Bradycardia
scenarios.description: Patient with symptomatic ventricular bradycardia requiring VVI demand pacing.
scenarios.objective: Increase the VVI pacing rate above the intrinsic 34–38 ppm rhythm with adequate output and sensitivity to achieve consistent ventricular capture.
scenarios.feedback: Start VVI pacing, set the rate to 60–70 ppm, output to 5–10 mA, and sensitivity around 2 mV to obtain paced QRS complexes.

rules.description: Loss of capture when pacing output is inadequate despite the higher rate

effects.feedback: Raise the output to at least 5 mA and reassess capture at the paced rate.

rules.description: Oversensing inhibits pacing when sensitivity is set too low

effects.feedback: Reduce sensitivity toward 2 mV so intrinsic signals do not inhibit pacing.

rules.description: Stable ventricular capture once rate, output, and sensitivity are set appropriately

effects.feedback: Paced rhythm should be stable at the selected rate with each spike followed by a QRS complex.
